These deterministic mock CFF fonts are copied unchanged from printpdf 0.12.8,
`tests/assets/fonts/mock/`, generated by its `scripts/gen_mock_fonts.py`.
Upstream: https://github.com/fschutt/printpdf/tree/v0.12.8/tests/assets/fonts/mock
License: MIT (included as LICENSE.printpdf).

Both use 1000 units per em; space advances 250 units, A advances 300,
B advances 350. A..J have real rectangular CFF outlines, .notdef/space
are empty. mock_cff_cid.otf has a nonidentity CID charset.

SHA-256 (unchanged upstream bytes):

- mock_cff_named.otf: d0b002ffefc81a0039198e864df401813908e4801a60be7f7ea4e9b7bdad2b62
- mock_cff_cid.otf: 3a431a2f812de240e4489e8e7b52b95b54b7beb089cb7c56eb233589bf2db434
